## Incident Overview

`_phase_resolve_threads` in plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh is ~200 lines with deeply nested logic: settling check, dispatch loop, batch commit, head-SHA reset, escalation tracking. The compound complexity contributed to repeated reviewer findings on this surface during the PR #37 remediation loop.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [5] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis flagged it as MINOR (coherent function, single polling-loop responsibility, refactor carries regression risk).

## Suggested Fix

Extract sub-functions: `_pr_check_settling`, `_pr_dispatch_unresolved_batch`, `_pr_handle_head_sha_reset`, `_pr_emit_escalation`. Defer until post-merge to avoid destabilizing the just-shipped happy-path.
data.title: merge-to-main-pr.sh _phase_resolve_threads: ~200-line function -> compound complexity hinders review
